q: Rewrite \( |-9| \) using the square root definition of absolute value.
c:
Solution:

Step 1

Recall the definition \( |x| = \sqrt{x^2} \):

\( |-9| = \sqrt{(-9)^2} \)


Step 2

Simplify the expression inside the square root:

\( \sqrt{81} \)


Final Answer:

q: Find the vertex and axis of symmetry of the function \( y = |x - 6| + 4 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

Compare with the form \( y = |x - h| + k \) to find \( h = 6 \) and \( k = 4 \):

\( \text{Vertex } (h, k) = (6, 4) \)


Step 2

The axis of symmetry is the vertical line \( x = h \):

\( x = 6 \)


Final Answer:

\( \text{Vertex: } (6, 4), \text{ Axis of symmetry: } x = 6 \)

q: Find the vertex and axis of symmetry of the function \( y = -|x + 3| - 2 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

Rewrite as \( y = -|x - (-3)| + (-2) \) to find \( h = -3 \) and \( k = -2 \):

\( \text{Vertex } (h, k) = (-3, -2) \)


Step 2

The axis of symmetry is the vertical line \( x = h \):

\( x = -3 \)


Final Answer:

\( \text{Vertex: } (-3, -2), \text{ Axis of symmetry: } x = -3 \)

q: State the range of the function \( y = 3|x - 2| + 5 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

Identify that \( a = 3 > 0 \), so the graph opens upwards with a minimum value \( k = 5 \):

\( y \ge 5 \)


Step 2

Write the range in set notation:

\( \{y \mid y \ge 5\} \)


Final Answer:

\( \{y \mid y \ge 5\} \)

q: State the range of the function \( y = -4|x + 1| + 7 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

Identify that \( a = -4 < 0 \), so the graph opens downwards with a maximum value \( k = 7 \):

\( y \le 7 \)


Step 2

Write the range in set notation:

\( \{y \mid y \le 7\} \)


Final Answer:

\( \{y \mid y \le 7\} \)

q: Find the solutions of the equation \( |x - 5| = 9 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

Set up two separate equations since \( 9 > 0 \):

\( x - 5 = 9 \quad \text{or} \quad x - 5 = -9 \)


Step 2

Solve each equation for \( x \):

\( x = 14 \quad \text{or} \quad x = -4 \)


Final Answer:

\( x = 14 \text{ or } x = -4 \)

q: Find the solution of the equation \( |x + 7| = 0 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

The equation \( |x - p| = 0 \) has only one solution \( x = p \):

\( x + 7 = 0 \)


Step 2

Solve for \( x \):

\( x = -7 \)


Final Answer:

\( x = -7 \)

q: Find the solutions of the equation \( |2x - 3| = 11 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

Set up two separate equations:

\( 2x - 3 = 11 \quad \text{or} \quad 2x - 3 = -11 \)


Step 2

Solve each equation for \( x \):

\( 2x = 14 \implies x = 7 \quad \text{or} \quad 2x = -8 \implies x = -4 \)


Final Answer:

\( x = 7 \text{ or } x = -4 \)

q: Find the solutions of the equation \( |3x + 2| = -5 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

The absolute value of any real number is always non-negative:

\( |3x + 2| \ge 0 \)


Step 2

Since \( -5 < 0 \), the equation has no solution:

\( \text{No solution} \)


Final Answer:

\( \text{No solution} \)

q: Find the solution set of the inequality \( |x - 4| < 6 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

Rewrite as a compound inequality since \( 6 > 0 \):

\( -6 < x - 4 < 6 \)


Step 2

Add 4 to all parts of the inequality:

\( -2 < x < 10 \)


Final Answer:

\( \{x \mid -2 < x < 10\} \)

q: Find the solution set of the inequality \( |x + 2| \le 5 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

Rewrite as a compound inequality since \( 5 \ge 0 \):

\( -5 \le x + 2 \le 5 \)


Step 2

Subtract 2 from all parts of the inequality:

\( -7 \le x \le 3 \)


Final Answer:

\( \{x \mid -7 \le x \le 3\} \)

q: Find the solution set of the inequality \( |2x - 1| > 7 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

Set up two separate inequalities since \( 7 \ge 0 \):

\( 2x - 1 < -7 \quad \text{or} \quad 2x - 1 > 7 \)


Step 2

Solve each inequality for \( x \):

\( 2x < -6 \implies x < -3 \quad \text{or} \quad 2x > 8 \implies x > 4 \)


Final Answer:

\( \{x \mid x < -3 \text{ or } x > 4\} \)

q: Find the solution set of the inequality \( |3x + 4| \ge 10 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

Set up two separate inequalities since \( 10 \ge 0 \):

\( 3x + 4 \le -10 \quad \text{or} \quad 3x + 4 \ge 10 \)


Step 2

Solve each inequality for \( x \):

\( 3x \le -14 \implies x \le -\frac{14}{3} \quad \text{or} \quad 3x \ge 6 \implies x \ge 2 \)


Final Answer:

\( \{x \mid x \le -\frac{14}{3} \text{ or } x \ge 2\} \)

q: Find the solution set of the inequality \( |x + 3| < -2 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

The absolute value of any real number is always greater than or equal to 0:

\( |x + 3| \ge 0 \)


Step 2

Since \( -2 < 0 \), the inequality has no solution:

\( \emptyset \)


Final Answer:

\( \emptyset \)

c:
Solution:

\( a > 0 \implies \text{minimum value is } k \)


Step 2

Extract the value of \( k \) from the function:

\( k = 12 \)


Final Answer:

\( 12 \)

q: Find the maximum value of the function \( y = -|x + 5| + 9 \).
c:

Step 1

Identify the form \( y = a|x - h| + k \) with \( a = -1 < 0 \):

\( a < 0 \implies \text{maximum value is } k \)


Step 2

Extract the value of \( k \) from the function:

\( k = 9 \)

\( 9 \)

q: State the domain and range of the function \( y = |x - 7| \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

The domain of any absolute value function is the set of all real numbers:

\( \text{Domain} = \mathbb{R} \)


Step 2

Since \( a = 1 > 0 \) and \( k = 0 \), the range is all \( y \ge 0 \):

\( \text{Range} = \{y \mid y \ge 0\} \)


Final Answer:

\( \text{Domain: } \mathbb{R}, \text{ Range: } \{y \mid y \ge 0\} \)

q: Find the solutions of the equation \( |4x - 8| = 16 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

Set up two separate equations:

\( 4x - 8 = 16 \quad \text{or} \quad 4x - 8 = -16 \)


Step 2

Solve each equation for \( x \):

\( 4x = 24 \implies x = 6 \quad \text{or} \quad 4x = -8 \implies x = -2 \)


Final Answer:

\( x = 6 \text{ or } x = -2 \)

q: Find the solution set of the inequality \( |x - 1| > 3 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

Set up two separate inequalities since \( 3 \ge 0 \):

\( x - 1 < -3 \quad \text{or} \quad x - 1 > 3 \)


Step 2

Solve each inequality for \( x \):

\( x < -2 \quad \text{or} \quad x > 4 \)


Final Answer:

\( \{x \mid x < -2 \text{ or } x > 4\} \)

q: Find the solution set of the inequality \( |2x + 6| \le 14 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

Rewrite as a compound inequality since \( 14 \ge 0 \):

\( -14 \le 2x + 6 \le 14 \)


Step 2

Subtract 6 and divide by 2:

\( -20 \le 2x \le 8 \implies -10 \le x \le 4 \)


Final Answer:

\( \{x \mid -10 \le x \le 4\} \)

q: Find the vertex of the function \( y = -3|x + 4| - 1 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

Rewrite the function in the form \( y = a|x - h| + k \):

\( y = -3|x - (-4)| + (-1) \)


Step 2

Identify \( h = -4 \) and \( k = -1 \) to find the vertex \( (h, k) \):

\( (-4, -1) \)


Final Answer:

\( (-4, -1) \)

q: Find the solutions of the equation \( |5x + 10| = 0 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

The equation \( |A| = 0 \) implies \( A = 0 \):

\( 5x + 10 = 0 \)


Step 2

Solve for \( x \):

\( 5x = -10 \implies x = -2 \)


Final Answer:

\( x = -2 \)

q: Find the solution set of the inequality \( |x - 5| \ge 0 \).
c:
Solution:

Step 1

The absolute value of any real number is always greater than or equal to 0:

\( |x - 5| \ge 0 \text{ for all real } x \)


Step 2

Therefore, the inequality holds for all real numbers:

\( x \in \mathbb{R} \)


Final Answer:

\( \mathbb{R} \)
